name: 14850 · Ithaca, NY
findings: ZIP 14850 (Ithaca) has 484 nonprofit organizations. 293 of them (61%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 264 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 14850 (Ithaca) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
48% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 14850 (Ithaca) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 264 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.
